Spoke with William at Automotive Excellence in Seal Beach. He mentioned that his boss previously signed up for Snap but had a negative experience, specifically disliking the 40% minimum interest rate. I explained that we offer a similar service but highlighted the key differences with EasyPay. We reviewed the 90-day same-as-cash option and that there is no cost for the shop to sign up. I also explained that with our program, the customer owns the vehicle outright, the garage gets funded, and the customer drives away in their vehicle.
